chunks: Muhammad b. Ahmad al-Sinani (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Abi Abdillah al-Asadi al-Kufi narrated to us. He said: Musa b. Imran al-Nakhai narrated to us from his uncle al-Husayn b. Yazid from Ali b. Salim from his father from Sa'd b. Turayf from Sa'id b. Jubayr from Ibn Abbas. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to Ali (peace be upon him):

O Ali! You are the Imam of the Muslims, the Commander of the Faithful, the Leader of the shining believers, the Proof of Allah after me over the whole creation, the Master of Deputies, and the Deputy of the Master of Prophets.

O Ali! When I was taken up to the seventh heaven, and from there to the Lote Tree of the Furthest Boundary, and from there to the veils of light, my Lord, exalted be His majesty, honored me with His intimate whisper. He said to me: 'O Muhammad!' I said: 'I am at Your service, my Lord, blessed and exalted are You.' He said: 'Surely, Ali is the Imam of My friends, a light for whoever obeys Me, and the word that I have made binding upon the pious. Whoever obeys him has obeyed Me, and whoever disobeys him has disobeyed Me. So give him glad tidings of that.'

So Ali (peace be upon him) said: O Messenger of Allah! Is my omen such that I would be mentioned there?! So he said: Yes, O Ali, so thank your Lord. So Ali (peace be upon him) fell in prostration, thanking Allah for what He had blessed him with. So the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to him: Raise your head, O Ali, for surely Allah has boasted about you to His angels.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful, exclusive title of Imam Ali
key_terms.إِمَامٌ: Divinely appointed leader of the Muslim community
key_terms.حُجَّةُ اللَّهِ: Proof of Allah, a designation of divine authority
key_terms.سِدْرَةُ الْمُنْتَهَى: The Lote Tree of the Furthest Boundary, the highest point reached during the Mi'raj
key_terms.مُنَاجَاةٌ: Intimate whispered conversation, here between Allah and the Prophet
key_terms.مِعْرَاجٌ: The Prophet's night ascension through the heavens

ai.seo_question: What titles did the Prophet give to Imam Ali?
